# Splitwise

Splitwise helps you split bills and expenses with friends and family.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/splitwise/.

## Actions

- **Add Friend**: Add a new friend to splitwise.
- **Create Expense**: Create a new splitwise expense.
- **Delete Expense**: Delete an existing expense by its id.
- **Delete Friend**: Delete an existing friend by id.
- **Get Categories** (read-only): Retrieve expense categories.
- **Get Currencies**: Retrieve a list of supported currencies.
- **Get Current User**: Retrieve information about the current authenticated user.
- **Get Group Info** (read-only): Action to retrieve information about a group.
